mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 60 degrees out by the Military Ridge State Trail. Enjoy the Waning Crescent moon, and prepare for an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain expected.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community input, will guide city development, housing, and infrastructure over the next decade.
Today is a great day to get out, with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Hop Haus Trivia and Thursday night fun at the ART House.

In our weekly report, on September 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash involving a 16-year-old operating an eMoto recklessly. The individual was cited for multiple violations including reckless driving.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, but please note that they are closing in 43 minutes, so you have just enough time to grab a scoop before they shut down for the night.
